catalog.tweaks.show-crash-details.name: Show details on the blue screen
catalog.tweaks.show-file-extensions.desc: Always show extensions such as .pdf and .exe so a file's type is obvious.

catalog.tweaks.show-full-path-in-title.d: File Explorer windows show the whole folder path, not only the folder name. Undo shows only the name again.

catalog.tweaks.show-this-pc-on-desktop.d: Adds the This PC icon to the desktop. Undo removes it again.
catalog.tweaks.show-this-pc-on-desktop.n: Show This PC on the desktop
catalog.tweaks.start-hide-app-tracking.d: Windows stops tracking which apps you open to fill Start and search. Undo turns tracking back on.
catalog.tweaks.start-hide-recent-files.d: Start and jump lists stop showing recently opened files. Undo shows them again.
catalog.tweaks.start-more-pins.descripti: Start shows more pinned apps and fewer recommendations. Undo returns to the default layout.
catalog.tweaks.start-more-pins.name: Show more pins in Start
catalog.tweaks.taskbar-align-left.descri: Moves the Start button and taskbar icons to the left, like Windows 10. Undo centers them again.
catalog.tweaks.taskbar-align-left.name: Align the taskbar to the left
catalog.tweaks.taskbar-never-combine.des: Each window gets its own taskbar button with a label. Undo combines them again.
catalog.tweaks.taskbar-search-icon.descr: Replace the wide search box with a search icon. Undo restores a search box.
catalog.tweaks.taskbar-search-icon.name: Taskbar search as an icon
catalog.tweaks.turn-off-mouse-accelerati: Make the pointer travel the same distance for the same mouse movement. Sign out if it does not change right away. Undo restores the usual Windows acceleration.
catalog.tweaks.verbose-status-messages.d: Windows says what it is doing during sign-in, sign-out, and shutdown, instead of only "Please wait".
catalog.tweaks.verbose-status-messages.n: Show detailed startup and shutdown messages

ui.DriversUpdate.ToolTip: Install the ticked driver updates and official packages. A restore point is created first when System Protection is on.

ui.t.a-calm-setup-helper-for-a-fresh-win: A calm setup helper for a fresh Windows 11 PC.
ui.t.a-profile-remembers-the-apps-tweaks: A profile remembers the apps, tweaks, and terminal choices. Loading it selects them in this window. It does not install anything until you press Install, Apply, or Set up terminal.
ui.t.choose-how-windows-update-behaves-o: Choose how Windows Update behaves on this PC. WinTool only writes Windows Update policies and service settings, and Default removes them all again.
ui.t.nothing-changes-until-you-press-app: Nothing changes until you press Apply
ui.t.optional-parts-of-windows-ticked-me: Optional parts of Windows. Ticked means on. Change the ticks and press Apply. Windows needs a restart after a change.
ui.t.pick-which-dns-servers-a-network-ad: Pick which DNS servers a network adapter uses. Automatic goes back to what your router hands out.
ui.t.repairs-for-common-windows-problems: Repairs for common Windows problems. Each one asks first and writes what it does to the log.
ui.t.save-what-you-picked-and-use-it-aga: Save what you picked and use it again after the next format. The sections below stay in a fixed tab row. Only the content of this panel changes.
ui.t.some-tweaks-only-show-up-after-file: Some tweaks only show up after File Explorer restarts.
ui.t.switch-to-advanced-to-change-any-pa: Switch to Advanced to change any part.
ui.t.the-scan-lists-driver-updates-windo: The scan lists driver updates Windows Update is offering right now. Optional updates are easier to review in Settings. Installing can take a while and may ask for a restart.
ui.t.this-is-winget-s-own-export-file-wh: This is winget's own export file, which can include apps that were not installed by WinTool. Import asks winget to install every package in the file.
ui.t.to-replay-a-profile-from-a-command-: To replay a profile from a command after the next format, run PowerShell as admin:
ui.t.wintool-uses-windows-update-and-lin: WinTool uses Windows Update and links to the graphics vendor. It does not install driver cleaner or booster tools. For a full driver scan, backup, and repair tools, open the Drivers tab.
